services.name: Bully Pulpit Golf Course
services.desc: Bully Pulpit is chiseled right out of the North Dakota Badlands in a site unlike any in the world. A round here is one you won’t soon forget. At Bully Pulpit Golf Course, you’ll find yourself fully immersed in the Badlands as you meander through meadows and woodlands, skirt along the Little Missouri River, and tee off from one butte to another. Voted USA Today’s #1 Best Golf Course in 2025, Bully Pulpit is a must-play for golfers looking for an unforgettable round. services.name: Medora Campground
services.desc: Conveniently located on the west side of Medora near Theodore Roosevelt National Park, the Medora Campground is the perfect place to set up your base camp for adventure in the Badlands. You can choose between our hook-up spaces or our rugged camping area, whichever makes your Medora experience perfect!
